pr_body:
This change attempts to fix testListTasksWaitForCompletion by setting bariers to
 verify task started on all nodes and had a chance to list all running tasks
 before canceling the TEST_TASK

Closes: #97923

comments:
Seems like this is still happening:

https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/mgx5rdd6e42v4/tests/task/:server:internalClusterTest/details/org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.tasks.TasksIT/testListTasksWaitForCompletion?expanded-stacktrace=WyIwIl0&top-execution=1

Here's another failure that should include the additional logging.

https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/6ptzkuu6uww3c/tests/:server:internalClusterTest/org.elasticsearch.action.admin.cluster.node.tasks.TasksIT/testListTasksWaitForCompletion

I had a failure of this on my local machine. I'm suspicious about this bit being called too soon:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/49f8446344311348f1d1602c0dd5b911137135a0/server/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/action/admin/cluster/node/tasks/TasksIT.java#L602-L604

This finishes the wait if _any_ task is unregistered, but there's lots of tasks that shouldn't trigger that (e.g. fault detection).

review_comments:
I am moving this to the test case specific to the list.
This is irrelevant to get task as it may or may not fork depending on the node receiving request and actually running the TEST_TASK
Hmm I don't follow this argument - doesn't the `storeResult == false` case have the same problem?
I should have clarified it, this waits for the list task to start on all nodes, not the test task, so it is specific to the list test case.
